meta.name: app-store-optimization
meta.description: Improves visibility and conversion in the App Store and Google Play — metadata, keywords, screenshots, ratings, and the listing experience that turns an impression into an install. Use this to audit or optimize an app listing, plan a launch listing, diagnose poor install conversion, or improve store search visibility.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你检查应用在 App Store 和 Google Play 的曝光与转化问题，分析标题、关键词、描述、截图、评分、评论回复和测试计划，并给出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你请求审计或优化应用商店列表、规划新应用上架、诊断安装转化率低或提升商店搜索可见性时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个App在App Store为什么下载量低。
say.note: Claude会分析可能的曝光或转化问题。

say.text: 优化一下我的Google Play列表的关键词和截图。
我要上架新App，帮我规划商店页面。

howto.what_en: Claude helps diagnose and fix App Store and Google Play visibility and conversion issues — metadata, keywords, screenshots, ratings, review replies, and testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit or optimize an app listing, plan a launch listing, diagnose low install conversion, or improve store search visibility.

say_en.text: Why is my app's download count low on the App Store?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze likely visibility or conversion issues.

say_en.text: Optimize keywords and screenshots for my Google Play listing.
Help me plan the store page for a new app launch.
say_en.note: Claude will propose title, description, and screenshots.
